_about: Settings for x3_ui.py. 'steps' are captured once per screen with: python x3_ui.py record <FUNCTION> (Playwright's 'Pick locator'). A data set with no steps is skipped. Function codes marked TO CONFIRM: open the screen in X3 and read the code from the page title / address bar. Read-only screens only.
_function_url_note: TO CONFIRM on first login: open any function (e.g. Order lines), copy the address bar, and check it matches this pattern with the folder and code in place.

so_lines.what: Sales order lines (Live Orders: customer dates, WO suggestions)

po_lines.what: Purchase order lines (Live Orders: material on order, due dates)

works_orders.what: Works orders: header, quantities, dates, status (Manufacturing > Enquiries)

wo_operations.what: Works-order operations: work centre, times, done

stock.what: Stock on hand, all products (Stock by site needs one product - use Requester or an Exports template)

products.what: Products, via Usage > Imports/exports > Exports with the product template, exported to the client

boms.what: BOMs, via Exports with the BOM template

routes.what: Routes, via Exports with the routing template

customers.what: Customers, via Exports (migration checks: compare with what we loaded)
